  AND '${hostname}' != ''

SELECT ROUND(MAX(ABS(z_score))::numeric,1) AS value FROM nmon_anomalies WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')

SELECT
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL'
    WHEN 'alert'    THEN '🟠 ALERT'
    ELSE                 '🟡 WARNING'
  END AS "Severity",
  hostname AS "Hostname",
  to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Snap Time",
  metric_source AS "Source",
  metric_name   AS "Metric",
  object_name   AS "Object",
  ROUND(metric_value::numeric,2)    AS "Current Value",
  ROUND(baseline_mean::numeric,2)   AS "Baseline Mean",
  ROUND(z_score::numeric,3)         AS "z_score",
  severity
FROM nmon_anomalies
WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
ORDER BY ABS(z_score) DESC, severity, snap_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Top NMON Anomalies by Deviation Score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(snap_time::date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
  NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical'),0) AS "Critical",
  NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='alert'),0)    AS "Alert",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='warning')            AS "Warning"
FROM nmon_anomalies
WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
GROUP BY snap_time::date ORDER BY snap_time::date

panels.title: Anomaly Count per Day — by Severity

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  metric_source AS "Source",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') AS "Critical",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='alert')    AS "Alert",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='warning')  AS "Warning",
  COUNT(*)                                    AS "Total"
FROM nmon_anomalies WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
GROUP BY metric_source ORDER BY "Total" DESC

SELECT
  metric_source AS "Source",
  metric_name   AS "Metric",
  object_name   AS "Object",
  COUNT(*)      AS "Times Flagged",
  ROUND(MAX(ABS(z_score))::numeric,2)  AS "Max Dev Score",
  ROUND(AVG(metric_value)::numeric,3)  AS "Avg Value",
  ROUND(AVG(baseline_mean)::numeric,3) AS "Avg Baseline"
FROM nmon_anomalies WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
  AND severity IN ('alert','critical')
GROUP BY metric_source, metric_name, object_name
ORDER BY "Max Dev Score" DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT
  CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN '🔴' WHEN 'alert' THEN '🟠' ELSE '🟡' END AS "!",
  hostname AS "Hostname",
  to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Snap Time",
  object_name   AS "CPU",
  metric_name   AS "Metric",
  ROUND(metric_value::numeric,2)   AS "Current Value",
  ROUND(baseline_mean::numeric,2)  AS "Baseline",
  ROUND(z_score::numeric,2)        AS "Dev Score",
  severity
FROM nmon_anomalies
WHERE hostname = '${hostname}'
  AND '${hostname}' != ''
  AND '${from_date}' != '' AND '${to_date}' != ''
  AND snap_time::date BETWEEN to_date('${from_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
                          AND to_date('${to_date}','DD-Mon-YYYY')
  AND metric_source IN ('nmon_cpu','nmon_cpu_usr')
ORDER BY ABS(z_score) DESC, snap_time DESC
